[Act: motor-vehicles
 Chapter: Offences, Penalties and Procedure
 Section: 181::Driving vehicles in contravention of section 3 or section 4.
]


Whoever, drives a motor vehicle in contravention of section 3 or section 4 shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three months, or with fine 5[of five thousand rupees], or with both.

metadata.section_title: Driving vehicles in contravention of section 3 or section 4.
